column1: # GE-T10's sixth question set (SMYSL-2.5 OQ-22's owed intent vocabulary, third round): sixteen
# questions, two per intent, each asked in the five tier-1 languages, eighty rows, over the
# committed corpus (`../gold/corpus.smy`). Only the front is scored on it, as on `../fifth/`.
# WHY A SIXTH SET. The fifth set's losses were constructions more than words. The rules for
# them were listed here, exactly, before a word of this set was written, and are scored on this
# set, whose front was taken before the code changed (`baseline.txt`). No rule is added or
# changed after a run of this set.
# THE RULES, DECLARED (from the fifth set's losses, and the one the fourth's declaration left out):
#        en  describe        de  was versteht man unter
#        es  en qué consiste / en qué consistía        fr  qui fut / qu'appelle-t-on
#        de  aus welchem grund   es  cómo es que   fr  comment se fait-il que / comment se fait-il qu'
#  16. a yes-or-no question as verification, as English `did`/`does` already are:
#        de  hat / haben / hatte        fr  est-ce que / est-ce qu'
#  17. attribution as doubt, and two forms missed:
#        en  who doubted   de  wer bezweifelte / wer behauptete   es  quién dudaba de
#        fr  qui doutait de   ru  кто сомневался в / кто верил во
#  18. how a thing arose, as trace:
#        en  how did … arise / where did … come from originally
#        de  wie entstand / wie entstanden   es  cómo surgió / cómo surgieron
#        fr  comment est né / comment est née / comment sont nés
#        ru  как возник / как возникла / как возникло / как возникли
#  19. location by another verb or by "which texts":
#        de  wo taucht … auf / wo tauchen … auf / wo ist von … die rede
#        es  en qué textos aparece   fr  dans quels textes apparaît
#  20. dependence as building or resting on:
#        en  what was built on / what is built on   de  was baute auf … auf / was baut auf … auf
#        es  qué se basaba en / qué se basa en
#        fr  qu'est-ce qui reposait sur / qu'est-ce qui repose sur
#        ru  что опиралось на / что опирается на
#  21. comparison by a verb of difference:
#        de  wie unterscheidet sich   es  en qué se diferencia
#        fr  … diffère-t-il de … / … diffère-t-elle de … (infixes)   ru  … отличается от … (infix)
# NOT DECLARED, ON PURPOSE: a bare preposition as a comparison (`frente a`, `contre`, `против`,
# `or`). Each is in questions that compare nothing (`la vaccination contre la variole`), and a
# rule that reads a preposition reads them too.
# WHO WROTE THIS. The same hand that declared the rules, after declaring them; half the
# questions reach for an opener none of the rules writes. Nothing was rephrased after a run
# but two rows: `sn-define3` in German and Spanish first asked about miasma, not John Snow — a
# translation of a different question — and were put back to the English one before the
# baseline was taken and before any rule changed.
# Single hand, so no agreement figure.
# Columns as `../gold/questions.tsv`: qid, intent, lang, question.
